minutes.headline: Committee approved the superintendent's goals, including a one-to-one device plan, and weighed a bring-your-own-device option.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with the superintendent's enrollment update, traffic changes at the high school, and safety training. The school building committee reported on site work for the new building. The committee approved withdrawing library books, approved the superintendent's goals after debating the 2022 device rollout date and a bring-your-own-device option, and deferred the second reading of two policies.

votes.motion: Declare the listed Turkey Hill Middle School media center books surplus and remove them from the collection
Waive/defer the second reading of the background checks and school lunch policies
Appoint a member as representative to the capital planning committee

budget_items.what_was_said: A warrant covers the first payment on a multi-year lease for the wireless installation at the primary school, now operational.
An option of a December to March bus pass was floated at roughly half the yearlong price.
Members discussed cost and replacement cycles of devices and asked for options laying out annual cost versus implementation date.

decisions.decision: Superintendent's team to look at bring-your-own-device option and a faster rollout, no later than FY22, presenting cost versus date options.
Student performance workshop to be scheduled after MCAS data, with dates to be settled by email.
Chair to send around dates for a goal-setting workshop.

what_happened.line: The School Committee took up the superintendent's goals, with a motion to approve them made after debate over a one-to-one device plan; the outcome was not audible.
Members asked the superintendent's team to look at a bring-your-own-device option and a faster device rollout, no later than FY22, with cost set against date.
A motion to declare listed Turkey Hill Middle School media center books surplus and remove them from the collection was made; the outcome was not audible.
The second reading of the background checks and school lunch policies was deferred.
The school building committee reported on site work for the new building, and the superintendent gave an enrollment update, traffic changes and safety training.

why_it_matters: A one-to-one device plan carries a recurring replacement cost, so the date and option chosen will shape future school budgets and, through them, the town budget, mostly taxes.
The new school building work reported here is a long-term commitment residents may be asked to vote on or pay for.
